notes: kb/Work PB924 (2026-09-22). --check 13.18.54.3 "Otherwise, SUM refers to the report writer SUM clause" -> OK 9). SUM carries subscriptTrigger for the keyword-omitted intrinsic SUM(...) (8.4.3.2.3 SR2), and the lexer pushed SUBSCRIPT mode at the '(' after a bare SUM everywhere, so `SUM (WS-K * WS-M)` in a report description entry died at the token inside the parens. SR9's discriminator is the REGION: the lexer now tracks the REPORT SECTION (opened by its header, closed by the next section/division header) and a SUM there no longer triggers SUBSCRIPT, so the '(' is an arithmetic LPAREN and the addend parses through reportValueOperand. FUNCTION SUM( stays FNARG_LPAREN in the report section, and the keyword-omitted SUM(...) outside it still captures (both arms pinned by the drift tests and the 2023 golden). kb/Work PB5652 (2026-11-22): SR9 is a 2014 rule (§2014:13.18.54.2 SR9; COBOL 2002 has none, and §2002:12.2.7.3 GR13 lets a REPOSITORY-declared SUM drop FUNCTION in a report entry), so editions are 2014 and 2023. The lexer's region exception now holds only where a clause can begin: where the entry owes an operand (after an operator, inside parentheses, after SOURCE IS / SUM OF / PRESENT WHEN / FROM / BY / a relational word) `SUM (` keeps the keyword-omitted call's paren, and from 2014 the binder refuses that tree by SR9 with COBOL7933 (IntrinsicBinder.ReportSumClauseWord) instead of a raw parse error; pb5652-report-sum-unprefixed-sr9 is refused COBOL7933 at 2014 and 2023.
